inventory.detail.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

inventory.groups_count.title: 库存与目标分层分组总数
inventory.groups_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

inventory.options.title: 库存与目标级联筛选选项
inventory.options.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 取某字段选项时将该字段筛选mode置all，保留父级条件；NULL也是一个选项。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

health.detail.title: 源库存健康度明细分页
health.detail.notes: 按统计日、仓库编码、SKU读取；相同重复值只取一次，冲突保持未知。age_days是最大库龄。名称优先取当前订单中的唯一非空SKU名称，订单无名称时才补出入库来源唯一名称，订单名称冲突不回退。名称均为当前参考，不回溯历史命名；左连接不改变库存行数。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；01/02基地仓、20分仓，其它分类排除；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS production_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 9, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (
SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2)) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
 a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN a.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02') THEN '基地仓' ELSE '分仓' END AS warehouse_type,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a
GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code,
 CASE WHEN a.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02') THEN '基地仓' ELSE '分仓' END
), inventory_batch_names AS (
SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.warehouse_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.warehouse_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name
FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code
), inventory_warehouse_bases AS (
SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(s.belong_base, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(s.belong_base, '')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base
FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s GROUP BY s.warehouse
), inventory_batch_source AS (
SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
 a.material_code AS material_code, a.warehouse_type AS warehouse_type,
 COALESCE(n.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name,
 n.material_group_name AS material_group_name, w.belong_base AS belong_base,
 a.total_qty AS total_qty, a.available_qty AS available_qty,
 a.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, a.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, a.age_days AS age_days,
 CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_overaged, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS overaged_qty,
 CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock,
 CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS safe_stock_qty, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS target_stock_qty,
 CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS current_stock,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS update_time
FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a
LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code
LEFT JOIN inventory_warehouse_bases AS w ON w.warehouseid = a.warehouseid
), product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), business_rows AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.belong_base) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.belong_base) = 1 THEN MAX(t.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_type) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_type) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_type) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.material_group_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.is_overaged) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.is_overaged) = 1 THEN MAX(t.is_overaged) ELSE NULL END AS is_overaged, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.overaged_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.overaged_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.overaged_qty) ELSE NULL END AS overaged_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.total_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.total_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.total_qty) ELSE NULL END AS total_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.is_low_stock) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.is_low_stock) = 1 THEN MAX(t.is_low_stock) ELSE NULL END AS is_low_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.is_high_stock) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.is_high_stock) = 1 THEN MAX(t.is_high_stock) ELSE NULL END AS is_high_stock, MAX(t.update_time) AS update_time, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, t.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.current_stock) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.current_stock) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.safe_stock_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.safe_stock_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.safe_stock_qty) ELSE NULL END AS safe_stock_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.target_stock_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.target_stock_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_stock_qty) ELSE NULL END AS target_stock_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.age_days) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.age_days) = 1 THEN MAX(t.age_days) ELSE NULL END AS age_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.pack_unit_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.pack_unit_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.pack_unit_qty) ELSE NULL END AS pack_unit_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.freeze_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.freeze_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.freeze_qty) ELSE NULL END AS freeze_qty, MAX(t.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), filtered AS (SELECT r.stat_date AS stat_date, r.belong_base AS belong_base, r.warehouse_type AS warehouse_type, r.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, r.material_group_name AS material_group_name, r.material_code AS material_code, r.is_overaged AS is_overaged, r.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, r.total_qty AS total_qty, r.is_low_stock AS is_low_stock, r.is_high_stock AS is_high_stock, r.update_time AS update_time, r.source_rows AS source_rows, r.warehouseid AS warehouseid, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.current_stock AS current_stock, r.safe_stock_qty AS safe_stock_qty, r.target_stock_qty AS target_stock_qty, r.age_days AS age_days, r.available_qty AS available_qty, r.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, r.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, r.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR r.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 = 'all' OR (:gea_p4 = 'equal' AND r.warehouse_type = :gea_p5) OR (:gea_p4 = 'missing' AND r.warehouse_type IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.product_categ_name = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.product_categ_name IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.material_group_name = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.material_group_name IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.material_code = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.material_code IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.is_overaged = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.is_overaged IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.is_low_stock = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.is_low_stock IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.is_high_stock = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.is_high_stock IS NULL))), order_sku_names AS (SELECT t.new_material_code AS sku, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.new_material_name), '')) AS name_count, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.new_material_name), '')) AS material_name FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi AS t GROUP BY t.new_material_code), flow_sku_names AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) AS name_count, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) AS material_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t GROUP BY t.material_code), sku_names AS (SELECT k.sku AS sku, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CASE WHEN o.name_count = 1 THEN o.material_name WHEN (o.name_count IS NULL OR o.name_count = 0) AND f.name_count = 1 THEN f.material_name ELSE NULL END), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name FROM (SELECT b.material_code AS sku FROM business_rows AS b GROUP BY b.material_code) AS k LEFT JOIN order_sku_names AS o ON k.sku = o.sku LEFT JOIN flow_sku_names AS f ON k.sku = f.sku LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.sku) SELECT r.stat_date AS stat_date, r.belong_base AS belong_base, r.warehouse_type AS warehouse_type, r.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, r.material_group_name AS material_group_name, r.material_code AS material_code, r.is_overaged AS is_overaged, r.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, r.total_qty AS total_qty, r.is_low_stock AS is_low_stock, r.is_high_stock AS is_high_stock, r.update_time AS update_time, r.source_rows AS source_rows, r.warehouseid AS warehouseid, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.current_stock AS current_stock, r.safe_stock_qty AS safe_stock_qty, r.target_stock_qty AS target_stock_qty, r.age_days AS age_days, r.available_qty AS available_qty, r.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, r.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, r.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, n.material_name AS material_name FROM filtered AS r LEFT JOIN sku_names AS n ON r.material_code = n.sku ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'overaged_qty' AND r.overaged_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'overaged_qty' AND :gea_p21 = 'asc' THEN r.overaged_qty ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'overaged_qty' AND :gea_p21 = 'desc' THEN r.overaged_qty ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'total_qty' AND r.total_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'total_qty' AND :gea_p21 = 'asc' THEN r.total_qty ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p20 = 'total_qty' AND :gea_p21 = 'desc' THEN r.total_qty ELSE NULL END DESC, r.stat_date ASC, r.belong_base ASC, r.warehouse_type ASC, r.product_categ_name ASC, r.material_group_name ASC, r.material_code ASC, r.warehouseid ASC LIMIT :gea_p18 OFFSET :gea_p19

health.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；01/02基地仓、20分仓，其它分类排除；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS production_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 9, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (
SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2)) AS DATE) AS stat_date,

 MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days

health.groups.atomic.title: 源库存健康度分层汇总分页
health.groups.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；01/02基地仓、20分仓，其它分类排除；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS production_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 9, 2) AS INTEGER) AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (
SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2)) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
 a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN a.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02') THEN '基地仓' ELSE '分仓' END AS warehouse_type,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a
GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code,

 a.total_qty AS total_qty, a.available_qty AS available_qty,

  FROM active_orders GROUP BY base, material
)

UNION ALL
SELECT 'pending_sku', o.base, o.material,
  CASE WHEN o.missing > 0 THEN NULL ELSE o.quantity END,
  CASE WHEN o.allocated_missing > 0 THEN NULL ELSE o.allocated END,
  CASE WHEN p.base IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN p.missing > 0 OR i.missing > 0 OR ib.base IS NULL THEN NULL

LEFT JOIN inventory_by_sku i ON i.base = o.base AND i.material = o.material

views.description: 含出口的订单计划执行来源，按订单日期归属筛选，并非所选日历史快照。同日期/基地/SKU/大区/省区相同的值只取一次，冲突或部分缺值保持未知。月计划及缺货归因字段会随订单日期重复，不能直接跨行求和；不替代内销订单指标或客户计划执行率。

views.title: 基地产销日记录
views.description: 按所选月初至读取日查询基地SKU日记录，展示源生产、调入调出、销售及次月计划。数量单位箱。日库存和月累计/滚动计划不能跨日期直接相加；此来源不是分仓库存、未来逐日排产或当前待发订单，名称及分类保留源值。 同一日、基地、SKU补充源已提供的发货日均、期初、调入/直调、主补销及周转字段；同键重复不重复累计，不把日快照跨天相加。

views.title: 基地实际发货
views.description: 以工厂发货来源plant_flag=工厂为范围，按实际发货日期汇总；正向量、负向量（负数量绝对值）和净量分列。保留未知基地组，不把分仓再次计入工厂发货。无本期记录保持空，不用30日日均乘30；数量先在SQL按基地SKU汇总。此来源为发货，不代表完整出库或库存周转。 按基地筛选时只表示已明确归属的记录，未知基地量不分摊。
